description:
Ever wondered where those cool things that you pip install come from? Have you thought about what it might take for you—yes, you—to create your very own package that others can install and enjoy?

This talk will talk about specific ways in which you can move from problem, to idea, to implementation, and lastly, packaging.

It might sound intimidating, but by the end of this talk, you will have the know-how to wrap up your own cool ideas and unleash them to the world!
title: Create a Python Package From Zero to Hero
